scenes.name: DJ Jazzy Jeff & the Fresh Prince y los DJs de Filadelfia
scenes.book: The Come Up: An Oral History of the Rise of Hip-Hop
scenes.author: Jonathan Abrams
scenes.desc: Jeff Townes y Will Smith debutaron con «Girls Ain’t Nothing but Trouble»; Simmons dudó, y Lady B, la DJ de radio de Filadelfia, les consiguió contrato en Jive. Rock the House (1987) y He’s the DJ, I’m the Rapper (1988), primer doble álbum del rap (uno del rapero, otro del DJ), con «Parents Just Don’t Understand», multiplatino, cuyo vídeo de Scott Kalvert fue el primero de rap con tirón en MTV y el primer contacto con el rap de muchos chavales de las afueras: de ahí saldría The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. Aunque Smith fue la estrella, el mayor impacto en la cultura fue el de Jazzy Jeff, «el Miles Davis del turntablism», que scratcheaba hasta con un balón: Filadelfia (Cash Money, Grandmaster Nell, Cosmic Kev) iba muy por delante en técnica.

scenes.name: Pete Rock & CL Smooth
scenes.book: The Come Up: An Oral History of the Rise of Hip-Hop
scenes.author: Jonathan Abrams
scenes.desc: Primo de Heavy D, Pete Rock scratcheó en «Gyrlz, They Love Me» y, cuando Kevy Kev tuvo un accidente, Marley Marl lo llamó para pinchar en su programa In Control de WBLS (1989), con diecisiete años: ponía sus maquetas en antena. Con CL Smooth grabó All Souled Out (1991) y Mecca & the Soul Brother (1992): cajas a todo volumen, cortes nuevos y vientos como nadie, el soul clásico y oscuro sampleado; un arquitecto del sonido de Nueva York que trabajó con Nas o Shaquille O’Neal (aunque dejó plantados a Shaq y, casi, a Will Smith, por ir a la peluquería).

xref.title: Meeting Will Smith (1994)
xref.body: She met Will Smith on the set of "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air" in 1994, and they married three years later. "She met Will Smith, you know him, on the set of The Fresh Prince of Bel Air in 1994. Three years later, they were married..."

xref.title: Acting Debut (2007)
xref.body: Willow debuted as an actress alongside her father, Will Smith, in the 2007 movie "I Am Legend." "She's an actor having debuted with Dad in the movie I Am Legend back in 2007."

xref.title: Actor, Rapper, and Songwriter
xref.body: Jaden Smith is noted for his multi-faceted career as an actor, rapper, and songwriter, following in the footsteps of his father, Will Smith. "He's now an actor, a rapper and songwriter just like Dad."

xref.title: Former Calabasas Mansion
xref.body: John Mayer's old mansion in Calabasas, a gated community in California also home to Will Smith, Justin Bieber, and Travis Barker, was used as a studio where USS co-wrote the song "Who's With Me" with a member of OneRepublic. "We wrote it with a guy that was in one republic and when I we he lived in John Mayor's old mansion."

xref.title: Live 8 Performance - Philadelphia
xref.body: Coldplay was one of the many artists and celebrities who appeared at the Live 8 global telecast benefit concert on July 2nd, 2005. "You too, audio, life, green day, Roxy music, James Brown, Nelson Mandela, Bill Gates, Brad Pitt, David Beckham, Ricky Gervais, Coldplay, Madonna, REM, the killer, Sting, the cure, Lincoln Park, Sarah McLaughlin, Will Smith, and Durand Durand, and a whole bunch of others."

xref.title: Parents' Musical Background
xref.body: Willow is the daughter of Will Smith, a rapper, and Jada Pinkett Smith, who is a singer for the new metal band Wicked Wisdom, indicating a strong musical lineage. "She's the daughter of Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith, two people have had their own music careers. Will is a rapper, of course, and mom is a singer of a new metal band called Wicked Wisdom."
